projects.title: TempMail Pro
projects.description: A temporary-email web app for receiving messages without using your primary email address.
features: Get a temporary email address
Copy the address for use where appropriate
Read incoming messages in the inbox
Refresh the inbox, including automatic refresh options
projects.need: Providing a temporary email address for tasks that do not require your primary inbox.
projects.access: Available on the web. Temporary addresses can expire or become inaccessible. Do not use them for banking, important accounts, or messages you need to keep.

projects.title: Coda
projects.description: A web music app for discovering songs and listening directly in a browser.
features: Browse music through Discover
Choose tracks from Speed Dial and Quick Picks
Explore playlist selections
Play music directly in the web app
projects.need: Discovering and listening to music in your browser.
projects.access: Available as a web app. Open Coda to try it; music availability depends on the source services. HiFi is a separate Android and desktop project that is still in development.

projects.title: SafeVideos
projects.description: A web-based tool for downloading video and audio from supported platforms using a media link.
features: Enter or paste a media link
Download video or audio when supported by the source
Use one web interface for multiple supported platforms
projects.need: Saving media from links. Only download content you have the right to download.
projects.access: Available on the web. Supported sources and download options can vary; this is not a promise of support for every platform. Respect content ownership and download permissions.
